title: Footballer Jamal Musiala collapses on pitch, reveals neurological dysfunction
summary: Bayern Munich footballer Jamal Musiala has spoken out after collapsing on the pitch twice in one week. He revealed that the collapses were due to a 'neurological dysfunction'. The condition has been explained by medical professionals. Harry Kane was praised for his reaction to Musiala's second collapse.
summary_points: Jamal Musiala collapsed on the pitch twice in one week.
Musiala stated the collapses were caused by a 'neurological dysfunction'.
The player's condition has been explained by medical experts.
Harry Kane received praise for his response to Musiala's second collapse.
